children: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. Sponsored ADR (TWSE:2330) posted a strong Q3 with $46.7B revenue and hefty margins as advanced nodes drive demand from NVIDIA, Apple and AMD; the company is accelerating global fabs, big Arizona investment and packaging expansion while warning of cautious 2027 cost risks.
Previous Week Recap
TSMC Q3 Revenue Growth, Margin
: TSMC (2330) Q3 revenue $46.7B (+50% YoY), net income NT$763.1B, gross margin 66.4%. Advanced nodes 79% of wafer sales (3nm 33%, 2nm 8%). 2026 capex $60–$64B; Q4 revenue guide $52.3–54.3B.
Arizona Fab Mass Production Target
: TSMC (2330) now expects mass production at its second Arizona fab in Q3 2027, reaffirming volume production at its Arizona sites in Q3 2027; company disclosed total implied investment.
Rising Wafer Demand From Major Customers
: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330) sees rising wafer demand from NVIDIA, Apple and AMD; industry sources expect capacity to climb ~10–20% to about 120,000 wafers/month by year-end.
Global Fab Roadmap, N2 Capacity
: TSMC (2330) outlined a global fab roadmap: ~20 fabs in development (13 in Taiwan, 5–6 abroad). N2 tech began HVM in late 2025, ramping in Taiwan; annual N2 capacity to more than double by 2027.
Expansion Plans: Arizona, Texas Consideration
: Taiwan Semiconductor (2330) plans major expansion: ~ $265 billion long-term Arizona investment with ongoing capacity adds; Texas expansion under consideration but seen as lower near-term priority.
Advanced Packaging Expansion

: TSMC (2330) expands advanced packaging: shipping 5x reticle-size packages, developing 9x and 14x, sticking with CoWoS, cutting packaging costs and partnering with GlobalFoundries on backend capacity.
Cautious 2027 Outlook, Costs
: Taiwan Semiconductor (2330) warned of a cautious 2027 outlook due to rising component costs and macro uncertainty, and plans careful capacity planning to balance customer demand and costs.
Traders Eye Margins, Cash Flow
: Traders watch Taiwan Semiconductor (2330): revenue jump’s impact on margins and cash flow, pricing trends, fab utilization, capacity costs, and management outlook for next quarter.
AI-Driven Demand, Utilization, Margins
: Traders note AI-driven demand from Nvidia for TSMC (2330), rising utilization of advanced nodes, and impacts on margins, valuation, ADR targets and investor positioning.
Samsung Uses TSMC 3nm for NVHBM Dies
: Samsung will use TSMC's 3nm process to make base dies for Nvidia's next-generation NVHBM. Samsung keeps standard HBM in-house and may consider in-house NVHBM if demand outstrips TSMC.
